utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there Saturday at the front porch. Just let me know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — the front porch is set. If you can bring whatever tools you already have, I’ll keep the rest of the schedule lined up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: 9 a.m. at the front porch works for me. Can you make it then?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, 9 a.m. at the front porch works for me — I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’m still in for Saturday at Sam’s front porch for the repair drive. I’ll check the time and get back to you so we can line up the helpers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik. It’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, so please use that new time and place when you check with the helpers.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Tess — I’m still lining up helpers for Saturday on my front porch, so if you can tell me what time works for you, I’ll fit you in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — just send me the time, and I’ll spread the word to the neighbors. We’ll make sure your repair drive has plenty of hands on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Rosa. Just send me the time, and I’ll let the neighbors know so we can get plenty of hands out for Sam on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess. It’s moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send the time so you can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: 9 a.m. at the front porch works best. Can you make that?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, 9 a.m. at the front porch works for me — I’ll be there and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’m still in for Saturday at Sam’s front porch for the repair drive. I’ll check the time and get back to you so we can line up the helpers.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thanks. Just send me the time when you have it, and I’ll be there if I can.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
